cohort: 15,040 women who delivered at Dr Ruth KM Pfau Civil Hospital, Karachi, Pakistan from 2016 to 2019, of whom 202 underwent emergency obstetric hysterectomy.
finding: The rate of emergency obstetric hysterectomy increased sharply from 0.37% in 2016 to 2.48% in 2019, with morbidly adherent placenta becoming the leading indication.
